profile.headline: IT Software Engineer 3 at Newport News Shipbuilding, A Division of Huntington Ingalls Industries
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with experience in all phases of the software development lifecycle. 7+ years of experience in creating web applications, architecting and implementing cross-platform solutions. Currently working in a mobile app development area. Enjoy technical challenges, teamwork, and creative problem solving and a supporter of the build it, run it, own it mentality.

company.name: Newport News Shipbuilding, A Division of Huntington Ingalls Industries

positions.title: IT/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and debugged web applications for clients using Visual Studio coded in C and VB, configured communications to database for data retrieval and storing. Upgraded applications for clients creating additional functionality (generating SSRS reports for viewing specified data; created functionality to perform tasks requested by clients). Upgraded application coding for proper functionality on newer operating systems (Windows Server 2003 to Windows Server 2012 and newer). Design and upgraded Databases for clients using SQL Server and Oracle. Deployed applications to client’s workstations and virtual machines at client’s site and remotely.

Modified and made repairs to desktop computers, laptops, peripherals, and software systems.  Assisted in installing, and servicing of hardware, software, and peripheral components such as computers, printers, and disk drives.  Provided technical assistance and training to system users.

Configuration and installation of network hardware and software packages such as Kepware, OSIsoft PI System, MS Office, etc., as requested by the client. This also included command line input and observation of system functions to verify correct system operation.

Responded to client and staff inquiries concerning systems operations.  Performed diagnostics of system hardware and software, to isolate operator problems via troubleshooting protocols.  Instructed users in the use of equipment, software, and technical manuals.

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description: Modified and made repairs to desktop computers/laptops, peripherals, and software systems, and provided technical assistance and training to system users.  Assisted in repairing, installing, and servicing of hardware, software, and peripheral components such as monitors, keyboards, computers, printers, mice, video projection equipment, CD drives, and disk drives.

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description:
Developed a data driven Expense Accounting System to accurately analyze business budgets and expenditures; Created data models to forecast projections of year to date earnings, track inventory sales pattern (high demand items versus low demand) report generation for multiple users or a single user; Designed a hierarchical model which allows access to data by limited users or a public view of data.

The Project was used to research and optimize industry best practice techniques to better develop industry standards.  Other facets included but were not limited to: 

Case Documentation - documenting all system scenarios including sub-flows and alternative flows; Screen Prototyping- developing screens to help draft Use Case and proposing actual screen designs; Case Realization- forming sequence diagrams or dynamic perspectives of the Use Case; Case Testing- creating test cases using the Use Case from the SRS and the Use Case realization from the SDS; Black Box Testing- Testing the website from the outside without looking at the code.
